items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Jelly Roll knew him and Jelly Roll came over to see Paul... Paul had a session coming up... Jelly Roll played a tune for him

ctx.x: He was born in France. Came over and they'd pronounce it different ways. Merez, and if you're in the north, they say Merez. Yeah, how you did for it. Yeah, and Merez, and depends on who's pronouncing it.
